purpose: RAN1#126 Case 1 mechanism matrix with explicit company-proposal numerical assumptions for a reproducible connected-mode relative-energy comparison.
claim_scope: single-UE abstract relative-energy and latency numerical discussion

timer_and_monitoring.note: The 5 ms period is 10 slots at the explicitly assumed 30 kHz SCS. The 2-symbol duration is 2/14 of a 0.5 ms slot, rounded to integer nanoseconds. Coupled WUS/DCP uses two 2-symbol occasions in consecutive slots; independent WUS uses one occasion per period. Annex E's separate 4 ms WUS-MO assumption is not mixed into the Table-12 Case-1 timing.

measurement.locator: R1-2603659 Annex E, extracted text B646
measurement.combination_note: Annex E supplies a connected-mode measurement power model but belongs to a separate company evaluation. Combining it with Table 12 is an explicit project scenario, not a reproduction of Table 13.

calendar_phase.interpretation: The primary matrix uses an explicitly aligned zero phase for reproducibility. The source documents do not require C-DRX, WUS and measurement calendars to be phase-aligned; de-aligned offsets are evaluated in the theory audit.

assumptions.lr_idle_power_unit: ASSUMPTION: LR is off outside a scheduled monitoring occasion; Annex E supplies WUS monitoring power but no LR off-floor value.
assumptions.dcp_monitor_power_unit: PROXY: DCP reuses WUS monitoring power because Annex E supplies no DCP power. Report DCP results as sensitivity-level evidence.
assumptions.mr_deep_sleep_power_unit: COMPANY_PROPOSAL: Annex E uses 1.1 instead of the TR 38.840 Table-18 reference value 1.
assumptions.state_selection: MR gaps use deep sleep only when the gap is at least 20 ms, light sleep at 6-20 ms, and micro sleep below 6 ms.

service.interpretation: Abstract single-UE payload service rate. A 0.5 Mbyte FTP3 packet occupies 5 ms of PDSCH at this rate. A calibrated scheduler/BLER model is not available.

statistics.interpretation: Simulate two C-DRX cycles before the fixed observation window and one PDB after it. Warm-up removes the artificial free transition at t=0; drain observes completion without adding post-window energy or new arrivals.

reporting_rules: Never call company-proposal numbers normative or agreed 3GPP parameters.
Report power saving together with completion, delay, PDB satisfaction, sample counts and confidence intervals.
Do not tune outputs to a desired case ordering; all cases use this frozen configuration.
Do not claim PHY calibration, conformance, absolute battery life or network energy saving.
